title: Same Start, Same Finish
statement:
A border of a word is a block that is both a prefix and a suffix of it, and that is shorter than the whole word. For example, `abcab` has the border `ab`. Borders of one word may overlap: `aaaa` has the borders `a`, `aa` and `aaa`. Find the length of the longest border.

## Input
One line containing the word `s`.

## Output
Print the length of the longest border of `s`. If the word has no border, print `0`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 100000`
- `s` contains only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
